subject: Pipeline -> Capacity: Weekly orchestration and GPU runway
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@orionhealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@cloudscale.ai>
Date: 2027-06-05T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Pipeline -> Capacity: Weekly orchestration and GPU runway

Team / Sam / Priya —

Kicking off this week's pipeline->capacity sync. Goal: validate the near-term GPU runway for the Orion Health pilot and surface any blockers (procurement, invoices, infra prep) that could change our reserved capacity ask.

Agenda (15m):
- Confirm commit windows for Orion Health (pilot -> scale dates)
- Runway scenarios and tradeoffs (latency tiers / quantization / burst credits)
- Action items for finance & infra (invoicing cadence, capacity reservations)

Attached: Orion forecast CSV (exports trimmed to weekly token estimates). Please review the highlighted Q3 weeks (lines 14-19) — those are when they expect ramp if the pilot succeeds.

Quick asks:
1) Laura — can you validate the model mix assumptions (gpt-large vs gpt-quant) in column H?
2) Marcus / Ben — what spare burst capacity do we have in us-west for the target weeks?
3) Sam — confirm procurement lead time and any billing constraints that would block a mid-July start.

Short call today at 3pm PT if we need it; otherwise I'll capture replies here and produce an action list.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: 2027-05-orion-forecast.csv (csv)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@orionhealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@cloudscale.ai>

Date: 2027-06-05T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline -> Capacity: Weekly orchestration and GPU runway

Diego — thanks for the head's up. I reviewed the CSV and made a few adjustments:
- Column H (model mix) had a conservative bias toward gpt-large; I've split the expected token mix 60/40 to gpt-large / gpt-quant for weeks 14-19, which lowers estimated GPU-hours by ~28%.
- Added a scenario sheet (runway-scenarios-v3.xlsx) with three runways: conservative, expected, stretch. See tab names and the short notes on infra implications.

Notes for infra/finops:
- If the customer converts to 8-bit quantized models for latency-sensitive endpoints, expect lower memory per instance but ~10% CPU overhead on pre/post processing.
- We should model two reservation options in the expected scenario: (A) 20% reserved + burst credits and (B) 40% reserved (higher monthly commit, lower per-token).

Attaching the scenarios. Happy to walk through the math in 3pm call.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, GTM Capacity Planning | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runway-scenarios-v3.xlsx (xlsx)]

Date: 2027-06-05T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline -> Capacity: Weekly orchestration and GPU runway

Diego/Laura — thanks for the fast turnaround. A few points from procurement and product at Orion: 

- Procurement: 3-week lead time for signed SOW + payment (we can accelerate with a PO + prepayment). Mid-July start is feasible if contract is signed by end of June.
- Product: we'll pilot with the expected scenario but want a safety buffer of burst credits in week 16 in case parallel testing increases calls.

Can you send a short table that maps the three runway scenarios to an invoice cadence option (monthly vs upfront) and the estimated monthly charge? That will let us present to Finance this week.

Sam Turner
Head of Product Integrations | Orion Health

Date: 2027-06-05T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline -> Capacity: Weekly orchestration and GPU runway

Looping infra/finops implications — quick summary:

- Us-west pool: we have ~120 reserved GPUs capacity currently unallocated across mid-July (can cover the expected scenario if we reserve ~30 GPUs for Orion during weeks 29-31).
- Burst credits: we can allocate an emergency burst bucket (up to 25% above reserved) but that requires a short-term finance approval for the incremental per-token uplift.
- Risk: if the customer requires dedicated tenancy in a single AZ, lead time for provisioning rises to ~10 business days.

Attached is a commit request form for the sales + finance signature path. If Orion can do PO + prepay, we can lock reservations and apply a 10% discount on the first quarter.

Ben Carter
Head of Cloud Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: commit-request-form.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps: 

Action items (owner / due):
- Laura: produce the mapping table Sam requested (scenarios -> invoice cadence & est monthly charge). Due: 2027-06-07 10:00 PT.
- Ben: reserve a tentative block of 30 GPUs in us-west for weeks 29-31 and provision a burst bucket (label: ORION-RD-4678). Hold until signed commitment. Due: 2027-06-10.
- Diego: circulate a one-page SOW template + commit request path to Orion (include PO + prepay discount language). Due: 2027-06-07.

If there's no objection, I'll schedule a 20-minute standup next Tuesday 8am PT to lock the final runway. Invite to follow.

Diego
